title: Add vertical manual scrolling and auto-scroll toggle to ShortSport

requirements.text: Update ShortSportPage to support TikTok-style vertical manual scrolling, where users can swipe or scroll up/down to navigate between video reels one at a time with snap-scrolling behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Each reel occupies the full viewport height and snaps into place when scrolling
Users can manually scroll up and down through video reels
Scroll snapping ensures only one reel is visible at a time

requirements.text: Add a floating auto-scroll toggle button in the bottom-right corner of ShortSportPage. When activated, the page automatically advances to the next reel at a set interval. Clicking the button again stops auto-scrolling. The button should visually indicate its active/inactive state.

quotes: Auto-scroll toggle button: Floating over the reels in the bottom-right corner

acceptanceCriteria: A floating button is visible in the bottom-right corner of the ShortSportPage
Clicking the button enables auto-scroll mode, which automatically advances to the next reel at a regular interval
Clicking the button again disables auto-scroll mode
The button changes appearance (e.g., color or icon) to reflect active vs inactive state
Auto-scroll stops when the last reel is reached or when manually toggled off

constraints: Do not change any backend logic or data models
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
nonGoals: Changes to the feed, explore, or any other pages
